classic.label: Classic white
classic.hint: White text with a black outline at the bottom. Reads well on almost any video.

movie.label: Yellow movie
movie.hint: Yellow text with a black outline at the bottom, like film subtitles.

reel.label: Reel bold box
reel.hint: Large white text in a dark box in the middle. Suits Reels, Shorts and Stories.

box.label: Light box
box.hint: Dark text in a light box at the bottom. Calm and easy to read.

top.label: Top line
top.hint: Small white text at the top, out of the way of the bottom of the screen where apps show buttons.
